messages.text:
The game started beeping when I find a pair. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed the beeping by removing the match and win tones from [use-game.ts](/work/src/game/session/use-game.ts). Matching and completion still use the existing game transitions.

Validation passed: 138 unit tests and 77 browser tests, including the full-game silence check. The production build and type checks also passed.
